text: I'm so sorry to be a nuisance at this hour, I'm minding my grandson Owen, he's 7. He knocked his head on the edge of the kitchen table earlier and cried straight off, then he was right as rain, chatting and playing like normal. But it's his neck that's bothering me. When I asked him to look down at his belly button he wouldn't drop his chin at all, he just moved his eyes down and kept his head stiff as anything. I tried again with a toy on the floor and he bent his whole back rather than his head. I don't know if I'm making a fuss over nothing, his mum's away and I didn't want to wake anyone. Sorry again
